hints.title: Prefix Minimum Tracking
hints.text: To maximize nums[j] minus nums[i] with i less than j, nums[i] should be as small as possible among elements seen before index j.

hints.title: Single Pass Update
hints.text: Maintain the running minimum value. For each subsequent element, compute difference if strictly greater, else update running minimum.

hints.title: Fallback for Strictly Decreasing Array
hints.text: Initialize the maximum difference to negative one. If no element exceeds previous minimums, return negative one.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(N) single scan across array of size N
variables: N: number of elements in nums
complexity.notes: Maintains running prefix minimum in constant space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Quadratic pairwise check takes O(N^2) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should solve in single pass with O(1) space, handling strictly non-increasing edge cases.
